name: Rainport
description: A noir harbor city under eleven years of rain. Shared by the iris_kale character and the Grate story demo.

entries.content: Rainport is a harbor city where it has rained without a break for eleven years, since the night the Halloran weather tower exploded. Umbrellas are a status symbol; the poor wear oilcloth. Trams run along the old sea wall.
Ninth Street has noodle bars, pawnshops and Iris Kale's office. The Ninth Street bridge crosses the Sluice, and whatever goes off the bridge ends up at the Grate downstream.

Eleven years ago Councilman Victor Halloran's weather-control tower exploded and the rain began. Iris Kale, then a police detective, proved it was sabotage; the department buried her report and she quit. Halloran is now the mayor.
The Grate is the iron storm grate where the Sluice drains into the harbor. Its night-shift keeper, Moss, fishes out whatever the river brings and sells what he finds before he reports what's left.
The Lucky Fan is the noodle bar under Iris Kale's office, run by Mrs. Teo. She hears everything through the floorboards and charges for gossip in dumplings.
The Blue Umbrella is Rainport's syndicate. It marks debtors' doors with a chalk umbrella. Members carry blue umbrellas with ivory handles, and carrying one without the right is a fatal mistake.
